_comment: Editorial half of the project manifest. The mechanical half — main_version,
latest_release, supported TYPO3 and PHP versions — is derived by
demo/build.mjs from ext_emconf.php and composer.json and must not be written
here. The page previously carried a hand-typed '0.2.0' while the extension
was at 0.4.0; that is the failure mode this split removes.
The build publishes the merged result at <site>/project-manifest.json, which
providers: Chrome's built-in Prompt API (Gemini Nano), running on the visitor's device

capabilities.label: Answers scoped to the current page
capabilities.detail: A configurable region of the page is the only source; the model is instructed to say so when an answer is not in it.

capabilities.label: No chat endpoint of its own
capabilities.detail: No server route, no database table, no cookie, no local storage, no telemetry.

capabilities.label: Editor-chosen fallback content
capabilities.detail: Visitors whose browser cannot run the model see a content element the editor picked, not an error.

capabilities.label: Model output cannot inject markup
capabilities.detail: Answers are built with DOM APIs only; a restricted Markdown subset becomes elements, everything else stays literal text.

security_controls.label: Administrator and editor prompt layers are separate
security_controls.detail: An editor may add a supplemental instruction but cannot replace the administrator's system prompt.

security_controls.label: Page content is treated as untrusted
security_controls.detail: The default system prompt instructs the model not to follow instructions found in the page. This reduces prompt-injection risk; it does not eliminate it.

security_controls.label: No HTML parsing of model output
security_controls.detail: No markup string is assembled; links are limited to validated HTTP and HTTPS URLs opened with rel="noopener noreferrer".

security_controls.label: The model download needs an explicit user action
security_controls.detail: The extension never triggers a multi-gigabyte download silently.

cost_controls.label: No per-request inference cost for supported visitors
cost_controls.detail: Inference runs on the visitor's device, so a supported visitor generates no provider call and no token spend. Unsupported visitors generate none either — they get the fallback.

ai.intended_purpose: Answering a visitor's question about the page they are currently reading, using the browser's own language model, with the page text as the only source.
excluded_uses: Site-wide knowledge search. The assistant sees one page.
Anything needing current external information. It has no network access of its own.
Transactions, or any action with a consequence. It answers; it does not act.
A guaranteed channel. Most visitors' browsers cannot run it, and they get the fallback instead.
Authorisation, legal, medical or financial decisions without independent controls.
models: Whatever model Chrome ships and manages. The extension neither chooses nor downloads it.
data: The visitor's question and the text of the configured page region.
Nothing else. No identifiers, no history, no analytics.
ai.human_oversight: The visitor asks, reads and judges. The assistant performs no action and changes nothing.
ai.permissions: Editors configure a plugin instance; administrators set the system prompt and the context selector in TypoScript. Visitors need no account.
ai.logging: None. The extension writes no log, no database row and no storage entry.
ai.retention: Dialogue state lives in browser memory and is destroyed on reset or navigation.
ai.cost_control: No inference cost arises: the model belongs to the browser.
security_controls: Separate administrator and editor prompt layers
Page content treated as untrusted input
DOM-only answer rendering, no HTML parsing
Model download only on an explicit user action
known_limitations: Only supported desktop Chrome versions with sufficient storage can run it. Everyone else sees the fallback — plan for that being the majority.
The model belongs to the browser vendor. Its behaviour, updates and availability are outside this extension's control.
Prompt injection through page content is reduced, not eliminated. Do not put secrets in publicly rendered content.
The model can be wrong or invent an answer. Scoping it to one page narrows the surface; it does not make it correct.
Answer quality depends on how well the page is written. A vague page produces vague answers.
